title: Calibrating LLM Uncertainty Words to Human Readers with Interval Type-2 Fuzzy Sets (code)
description: Code that reproduces all experiments, tables and figures of the article "Calibrating LLM Uncertainty Words to Human Readers with Interval Type-2 Fuzzy Sets". ReadCal estimates claim reliability from the self-consistency of an LLM with a nine-rule fuzzy engine, models how 165 survey respondents read 15 probability phrases as interval type-2 fuzzy sets, and chooses for each claim the phrase with the lowest expected Brier loss for the worst-served reader group. The data are public and are downloaded from fixed versions with checksums.
